steps.text:
I did not build the chain yet, because the request as written can't be met. The sizes are confirmed: outer length 30 mm, outer width 18 mm, wire 3 mm, link thickness 3 mm, 24 mm pitch.

Two oval rings that lie flat on the bed in the same plane cannot pass through each other, so a chain that prints fully flat will not come off the bed linked. Real linked links need alternate links to stand on edge, and that is not flat printing.

Which do you want?
- **Linked, with alternate links standing on edge.** This meets "comes off already linked" but not "prints flat". I would need to work out how the standing links clear the flat ones on the bed, which is more design work.
- **Flat, all eight links lying side by side with ends overlapping at a small Z gap.** This prints flat, but the links are not truly linked; they can be pulled apart.

Tell me which one and I'll build it.
